```{r setup}
suppressMessages(library(ggplot2)) #plots

suppressMessages(library(magrittr)) #pipes %>%
suppressMessages(library(RColorBrewer)) #color palettes

suppressWarnings(library(patchwork)) #compose plots
```

## Section 1: Access to gene expression data

Get data from GTEx Portal.

```{r section1}
# Access to GTEx Portal -> RNA-seq data for:
# Calcium homeostasis modulator: CALHM1,2,..6
calhm <- get_gene_expression(gencodeIds = c("ENSG00000185933.7", "ENSG00000138172.11",
                                            "ENSG00000183128.7", "ENSG00000164451.14",
                                            "ENSG00000178033.6", "ENSG00000188820.13"),
                             datasetId = "gtex_v10", itemsPerPage = 1000) #force GTEx v10
glimpse(calhm)

# Connexins: n = 22 (1 repeated)
#('GJC3','GJA1', 'GJA10', 'GJA3', 'GJA4', 'GJA5', 'GJA8', 'GJA9', 'GJB1', 'GJB2', 'GJB3', 'GJB4', 'GJB5', 'GJB6', 'GJB7', 'GJC1', 'GJC2', 'GJC3'**rep**, 'GJD2', 'GJD3', 'GJD4', 'GJE1')
conx <- get_gene_expression(gencodeIds = c("ENSG00000176402.6", "ENSG00000152661.9", "ENSG00000135355.4",
                                           "ENSG00000121743.4", "ENSG00000187513.9", "ENSG00000265107.3",
                                           "ENSG00000121634.6", "ENSG00000131233.10", "ENSG00000169562.13",
                                           "ENSG00000165474.8", "ENSG00000188910.8", "ENSG00000189433.7",
                                           "ENSG00000189280.3", "ENSG00000121742.19", "ENSG00000164411.12",
                                           "ENSG00000182963.11", "ENSG00000198835.4", "ENSG00000159248.5",
                                           "ENSG00000183153.7", "ENSG00000177291.4", "ENSG00000203733.5"),
                            datasetId = "gtex_v10", itemsPerPage = 2000)
glimpse(conx)

# Pannexins: PANX1..3
panx <- get_gene_expression(gencodeIds = c("ENSG00000110218.9", "ENSG00000073150.14", "ENSG00000154143.3"),
                            datasetId = "gtex_v10", itemsPerPage = 1000)
glimpse(panx)

# Plot testing data vs tissueSiteDetailId, geneSymbol
#tmp2 <- calhm %>% unnest(data) %>% View()
#tmp2 %>% ggviolin(x = "tissueSiteDetailId", y = "data", color = "geneSymbol", add = "jitter",
#                  legend = "none", size = 0.35, add.params = list(size = 1, alpha = 0.7))

# Merge datasets
genes <- bind_rows(calhm, conx, panx)
dim(genes)

# Filter to selected tissues (n = 20)
# note that not all `tissueSiteDetailId` are in $tissues
tissues <- c("Adipose tissue", "Bladder", "Bowel", "Brain", "Breast", "Bronchium", "Esophagus",
             "Gallbladder", "Gastrointestinal soft tissue", "Kidney", "Liver", "Lung", "Oral cavity",
             "Ovary", "Prostate", "Skeletal muscle", "Skin", "Synovium", "Thyroid gland", "Uterus")

# Define mean TPM value per row
genes_hm <- genes %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(mean_tpm = mean(data)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(tissue = str_replace_all(tissueSiteDetailId, "_", " ")) %>% #remove '_' from tissues
  select(geneSymbol, tissue, mean_tpm) %>% #drop some columns
  pivot_wider(names_from = tissue, values_from = mean_tpm) %>% #pivot tissue to columns
  data.frame(row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE) #set genes as row names

# Normalize outliers. Use log10(TPM+1) to avoid zeroes (pseudocount)
genes_hm_v2 <- log10(genes_hm + 1)

# Review: filter those columns that are non-solid tissues
genes_hm_v2 <- genes_hm_v2 %>%
  select(-c("Cells EBV-transformed lymphocytes", "Cells Cultured fibroblasts"))

# Calculate per gene sum and avg (row-wise)
genes_hm_v2_export <- genes_hm_v2 %>%
  rownames_to_column("Genes") %>% #to keep genes
  rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Sum = sum(c_across(where(is.numeric)), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Avg = mean(c_across(where(is.numeric)), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Export table
#write.table(genes_hm_v2_export, "GTEx_genes_TPM_log10.tsv", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
```

### Plot heatmaps

Plot gene expression data across different tissues.

```{r plots1, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 8, out.width = "100%"}
# Set colors for TPM values
tpm_colors <- colorRamp2(c(0, 1, 2, 3), c("white", "#5073ad", "#c5849d", "#793850"))

# Plot full heatmap
Heatmap(as.matrix(genes_hm_v2), border = TRUE, col = tpm_colors,
        row_title = "Genes", column_title = "Tissues",
        heatmap_legend_param = list(title = expression("log"[10]*"(TPM)"),
                                    title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold")),
        row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10), column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10))

# Calculate column-wise variances
genes_hm_v2_var <- apply(genes_hm_v2, 2, var)

# Keep the 50% most variable columns <-> tissues
genes_hm_v2_idx <- order(genes_hm_v2_var, decreasing = TRUE)[1:round(0.5 * ncol(genes_hm_v2))]
genes_hm_v2_sel <- genes_hm_v2[, genes_hm_v2_idx] #match cols

# Plot filtered heatmap
plot_hm_sel <- Heatmap(as.matrix(genes_hm_v2_sel), name = "log10(TPM+1)",
                       row_title = "Genes", column_title = "Tissues",
                       col = tpm_colors, border = TRUE)
draw(plot_hm_sel, merge_legend = TRUE)
```

## Section 2: Differential gene expression

Explore overexpressed genes across different tissues using transcriptomic data.

```{r section2, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 8, out.width = "100%"}
# Read pre-processed data: 1 means a gene is overexpressed
genes_upreg <- read.csv("data/upregulated.tsv", sep = "\t", check.names = FALSE)
colnames(genes_upreg)[1] <- "gene"
genes_upreg <- genes_upreg %>% column_to_rownames("gene")

# Set colors
upr_colors <- colorRamp2(c(0, 1), c("white", "#385079"))

# Plot heatmap
plot_hm_upreg <- Heatmap(as.matrix(genes_upreg), border = TRUE, col = upr_colors,
                         row_title = "Genes", column_title = "Tissues", show_heatmap_legend = FALSE,
                         row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10), column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
                         rect_gp = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 1))
draw(plot_hm_upreg, merge_legend = TRUE)
```

## Section 3: log2 fold change

Process and visualize upregulated or downregulated genes identified from the transcriptomic data. [REV]

```{r section3, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 8, out.width = "100%"}
# Read data: >0 means a gene is upregulated
data_genes <- read.xlsx("data_rev/data_figure2.xlsx")
glimpse(data_genes)

# Convert data table to wide using log2FC (col: M2.log2FC)
log2fc_mat <- data_genes %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene, Tissue, M2.log2FC) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Tissue,
              values_from = M2.log2FC) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Gene") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Create gene labels according to:
# '*': label if both cols D (M0matched.FDR) and F (M2.FDR) <= 0.05
# '+': label if col M (P1.FDR) <= 0.05
genes_label <- data_genes %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sign_fdr_m = M0matched.FDR <= 0.05 & M2.FDR <= 0.05,
    sign_fdr   = P1.FDR <= 0.05,
    
    label = case_when(
      sign_fdr_m & sign_fdr ~ "*+",
      sign_fdr_m            ~ "*",
      sign_fdr              ~ "+",
      TRUE                  ~ "" #empty when no labels
    )
  )
genes_label_star <- data_genes %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sign_fdr_m = M0matched.FDR <= 0.05 & M2.FDR <= 0.05,
    
    label = case_when(
      sign_fdr_m ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "" #empty when no labels
    )
  )

# Pivot labels into a matrix
label_mat <- genes_label %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene, Tissue, label) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Tissue,
    values_from = label,
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Gene") %>%
  as.matrix()
label_mat[is.na(label_mat)] <- "" #NA to empty

label_mat_star <- genes_label_star %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene, Tissue, label) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Tissue,
    values_from = label,
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Gene") %>%
  as.matrix()
label_mat_star[is.na(label_mat_star)] <- "" #NA to empty

# Both matrices have the same rownames and colnames order

# Create a clustering matrix
log2fc_mat_clust <- log2fc_mat

for (i in seq_len(nrow(log2fc_mat_clust))) {
  if (!all(is.na(log2fc_mat_clust[i, ]))) {
    log2fc_mat_clust[i, is.na(log2fc_mat_clust[i, ])] <-
      mean(log2fc_mat_clust[i, ], na.rm = TRUE) #handle NA values
  }
}

# Calculate the clustering separately
row_hc <- hclust(dist(log2fc_mat_clust))
col_hc <- hclust(dist(t(log2fc_mat_clust)))

# Set colors
hm_colors <- colorRamp2(
  c(-4, -2, 0, 2, 4),
  c("#793850", "#c5849d", "white", "#5073ad", "#385079")
)

# Plot heatmap nº1 (star + plus labels)
plot_hm_log2fc <- Heatmap(
  log2fc_mat, border = TRUE, col = hm_colors,
  row_title = "Genes", column_title = "Tissues", na_col = "gray90",
  cluster_rows = row_hc, cluster_columns = col_hc,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = expression(bold("log"[2]*" FC")),
    title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12)
  ),
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10), column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  #add labels
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    if (!is.na(label_mat[i, j]) && label_mat[i, j] != "") {
      grid.text(
        label_mat[i, j],
        x = x,
        y = y,
        gp = gpar(fontsize = 8)
      )
    }
  }
)
draw(plot_hm_log2fc, merge_legend = TRUE)

# Export via code
png("plots_rev/Fig2_Heatmap_log2FC.png", width = 8, height = 7, units = "in", res = 300)
draw(plot_hm_log2fc, merge_legend = TRUE)
dev.off()

# Plot heatmap nº2 (only star labels)
plot_hm_log2fc_v2 <- Heatmap(
  log2fc_mat, border = TRUE, col = hm_colors,
  row_title = "Genes", column_title = "Tissues", na_col = "gray90",
  cluster_rows = row_hc, cluster_columns = col_hc,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = expression(bold("log"[2]*" FC")),
    title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12)
  ),
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10), column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  #add labels
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    if (!is.na(label_mat_star[i, j]) && label_mat_star[i, j] != "") {
      grid.text(
        label_mat_star[i, j],
        x = x,
        y = y,
        gp = gpar(fontsize = 8)
      )
    }
  }
)
png("plots_rev/Fig2_Heatmap_log2FC_star.png", width = 8, height = 7, units = "in", res = 300)
draw(plot_hm_log2fc_v2, merge_legend = TRUE)
dev.off()

# Option: replace '+' labels with cell border
p1_sign_mat <- data_genes %>%
  dplyr::mutate(p1_sig = P1.FDR <= 0.05) %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene, Tissue, p1_sig) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Tissue, values_from = p1_sig) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Gene") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Plot heatmap nº3 (star labels and cell border)
plot_hm_log2fc_v3 <- Heatmap(
  log2fc_mat, border = TRUE, col = hm_colors,
  row_title = "Genes", column_title = "Tissues", na_col = "gray90",
  cluster_rows = row_hc, cluster_columns = col_hc,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = expression(bold("log"[2]*" FC")),
    title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12)
  ),
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10), column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  #add labels
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    #star labels
    if (!is.na(label_mat_star[i, j]) && label_mat_star[i, j] == "*") {
      grid.text(
        "*",
        x = x,
        y = y,
        gp = gpar(fontsize = 8)
      )
    }
    #set border for those cells = TRUE
    if (!is.na(p1_sign_mat[i, j]) && p1_sign_mat[i, j]) {
      grid.rect(
        x = x,
        y = y,
        width = width,
        height = height,
        gp = gpar(fill = NA, col = "black", lwd = 0.75)
      )
    }
  }
)
png("plots_rev/Fig2_Heatmap_log2FC_star_border.png", width = 8, height = 7, units = "in", res = 300)
draw(plot_hm_log2fc_v3, merge_legend = TRUE)
dev.off()
```
